shortDescription: Obtain a “master” token (valid for Rancher's “Norman” API)

options.name: cluster_name
options.description: The name of the cluster to create a token for.

options.name: impersonate
options.description: The name of the user to impersonate. (Equal to the C(.username) of the C(kind: User) object to impersonate). User must already exist.

options.name: stem
options.description: The prefix to use for the Kubernetes C(name) in case a new token needs to be created. Must end with a dash.

options.name: validity
options.description: The validity time of new tokens, as a string formed of digits optionally followed by a time unit picked among 's', 'm' (or equivalently) 'min', 'h' or 'd'. 's' is the default time limit.
